abstract: A 29-year-old man was admitted to our hospital due to bilateral testicular tumors. The bilateral testicular tumors were palpated and visualized by ultrasound and magnetic resonance imaging (right 8 cm, left 6 cm in diameter). Bilateral high orchiectomies were performed after frozen storage of the sperm. Pathological examination revealed seminoma and immature teratoma in the right testis and seminoma in the left testis. Three months later, computed tomography (CT) showed multiple metastatic lung nodules. In addition, positron emission tomography (PET)-CT examination revealed peri-caval lymph node metastasis together with the lung metastases. Lung metastases disappeared, but the lymph node metastasis reduced and remained after 3 courses of combination chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin. PET-CT examination revealed that no uptake of FDG was seen in the lung and lymph nodes. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection was performed. No viable tumor cells were histologically present in the excited lymph nodes. The postoperative course was good and uneventful at 10 months under androgen replacement therapy without disease recurrences.
abstract_ja: 29歳男性が両側精巣腫瘍のため入院した。両側精巣腫瘍は触診、超音波検査、磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)で確認された（右8cm、左6cm）。精子の凍結保存後、両側高位精巣摘除術を施行した。病理学的検討で、右精巣はセミノーマと未熟奇形腫、左精巣はセミノーマと診断された。3か月後のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で多発肺転移結節を認めた。さらに陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)-CT検査で、肺転移とともに傍大静脈リンパ節転移が明らかになった。BEP併用化学療法3コース後、肺転移は消失したが、リンパ節転移は縮小したものの残存した。PET-CTでは肺とリンパ節にFDG集積は認められなかった。後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した。摘出リンパ節に生存腫瘍細胞は組織学的に認めなかった。術後経過は良好で、アンドロゲン補充療法下で10か月間再発なく経過した。
